t: This is the Stanley Atkinson Clock Tower in Stepney. It commemorates Stanley Bean Atkinson, who lived from 1873 to 1910. He is described as a noble citizen, a barrister-at-law, a Stepney Borough Councillor, a guardian of the poor, and a member of the Metropolitan Asylums Board. So the tower stands as a tribute to a man who gave his working life to public service in this part of London.
